scope_and_limitations: M1, M2 and M4 each use their own persistent world; groups run independently in parallel. Counts are mechanism witnesses, not statistical samples or model scores.
M1 has 13 checks and dynamically adds C only in the lifecycle trajectory. M2 has 14 checks with A/B. M4 has 14 checks with A/B only, using A::work-2 for executable incomplete content.

M4 accepts one aggregated JSON or two split JSONs and independently checks top-level required field presence/conflicts. It does not verify numerical correctness, finance realism or general professional quality.
delivery_only records an owner-attributed accepted result with decision_basis=delivery_only; no external approve tool occurs in M4. This should not be described as manager approval.
M2 same-text-key cross-project commands use the same actor alice and identical payload, with an explicit local B create_object grant; actor differences cannot explain independent identity.
Rejected package atomicity compares the declared business prefix and all registered immutable/mirror bytes; clock, rejected Q/O and command journal bookkeeping are excluded explicitly.

protocol.scope: Finite synthetic JSON, one world per independent group, real runtime actions; no model or domain-quality claim.
protocol.delivery_only: Runtime stores an owner-attributed accepted decision with decision_basis=delivery_only in the review record; these trajectories execute no approve action or external reviewer.

checks.comparison_actually_executed: Full Python structure equality before condensation; not a hash-only experiment.

condensation.omitted: Only the repeated large expected/observed business-prefix bodies in M1 invalid_package_business_prefix_unchanged, replaced by canonical digests and explicit raw location. Snapshot bodies remain raw files.
condensation.retained: All 41 named expected/observed checks, protocol, outcomes, errors and not-executed counts, state/file references, per-snapshot version/mirror hashes and source identities.
condensation.canonical_hash_encoding: SHA256 of finite UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon).
